name: Lofts of Thraben Cathedral
description: The long-abandoned upper halls of the cathedral where the angels will return and Dovid prepares the space.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, with the angel Gryta, summons Dovid and orders him to prepare the forbidden space of the Lofts of Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: You, and you alone, must prepare that space previously forbidden.

timeline.summary: Gryta opens a bricked window into the Lofts for Dovid and tells him to clear the cistern.
timeline.quote: The bricked window folded into itself silently

timeline.summary: In the cistern Dovid finds a preserved, strangled man in black with a book in his coat, which he seals in a nameless crypt and takes the book.
timeline.quote: He had been strangled, and although there were no signs of rot, he was murdered some time before

pages_say.description: The long-abandoned upper halls of the cathedral where the angels will return and Dovid prepares the space.
